violations.message: "on_accept" is ignored for routing on a "checkout_step" page — it means where the shopper goes after accepting the offer on this page, which only "upsell" or "downsell" can satisfy. This page routes forward to "checkout-1" instead.

"success_url" is ignored for routing on a "checkout_step" page — it means where the shopper goes after payment succeeds, which only "checkout" can satisfy. This page routes forward to "checkout-1" instead.
